policy_followup_2026_11_05.additional_control: A pre-existing single-quoted multiline word could hide a following real operation; preserve quote-owned hashes instead of dropping the physical line.
policy_followup_2026_11_05.implementation: Share fixed awk comment-boundary, physical-newline provenance and work-budget helpers between the statement parser and a quote-aware policy reader. Preserve conservative inline-comment refusal controls.
policy_followup_2026_11_05.rejected_input_refinement: A NUL-record stdin variant produced six supervisor/compound control failures on native awk and was fully reverted. The selected canonical and test bytes equal the already passing family run.
policy_followup_2026_11_05.identity_scope: Measured working-tree source, with committed HEAD retained separately. New committed-head quality, hosted, official-package and production acceptance remain pending.
